population: All model-available spots in exacthex stromal bands of each source-eligible paired patient, separately by resource. Attempt all original eligible pairs and retain absent/failed models, spot-filter losses and infeasible cases.
reference: Common official RCTD pinned7 known groups, same source1400 true cells; pilot qualification and all22 fits precede calibration. Keep author8 abundance sensitivity separately.
composition_features: Seven normalized native RCTD weights per spot, each divided by equal-region pooled RMS (floor1e-6). These are RNA mixture shares, not author model absolute abundance or measured cell fractions. Native row sum is preserved diagnostic, not a calibrated physical-cell burden.
QC: log1p original full-feature total UMIs, log1p original detected gene IDs, original mitochondrial UMI fraction; never recompute these on shared model genes.
summaries: Paired sections within actual patient, each resource and each tier separately. Keep near,far,far-minus-near and old full/model-available/spot+UMI matched controls on identical patients. Mean-only and strict-distribution subsets separately, failed strict support NA, never zero.
interpretation: Outcome-informed conditional RNA-mixture sensitivity. Broader gene panel mostly participated in model fitting; seven excluded known readouts are not novel independent validation. No cell-specific expression, clinical adjustment, causal attribution, general far-reference superiority or extra spatial patient N.
